crossRefs.note: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and…

Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.
The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

translations.web: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
translations.bsb: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
translations.kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
translations.asv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
